caption: The drawing features a central object that appears to be a rounded, irregularly-shaped container or vessel with a small cylindrical protrusion on the right side. The vessel is predominantly brown with darker and lighter tonal variations giving it a textured, dimensional effect, and it has a decorative band near the top in a purplish hue with a wavy line pattern. There is also a circular, medallion-like detail on the side of the vessel. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, bordered by a thin, faint rectangular line framing the central image. In the top left corner and bottom right corner, there are two separate rectangular sections containing reddish-brown illustrations. The top left rectangle shows a floral or plant motif with leaves and small flowers, filled with dark outlines on a reddish-brown field. The bottom right rectangle contains the profile of a human face looking left, holding a flower near the nose, with stylized, linear features and similarly colored to the floral motif in the other rectangle. The overall composition uses brown and reddish-brown color tones for the illustrated elements, while the background remains neutral.
title: Slip Cup
